name: Manasseh
summary: A son of Hezekiah who became king of Judah at twelve and led the people into more evil than the nations before them. Taken in chains to Babylon, he humbled himself, and the LORD brought him home.

key_moments.title: Undoing His Father's Work
key_moments.description: Manasseh rebuilt the high places his father had torn down, set up altars to Baal, and built altars inside the LORD's house. He even put his son through the fire and dealt with spirits and wizards.

key_moments.title: Fills Jerusalem with Innocent Blood
key_moments.description: The LORD said through His prophets that He would bring great trouble on Jerusalem for what Manasseh had done. Manasseh also shed so much innocent blood that it filled Jerusalem from end to end.

key_moments.title: Humbled in Babylon
key_moments.description: The LORD let the king of Assyria's captains bind Manasseh in chains and carry him to Babylon. There he humbled himself and prayed, and the LORD brought him back to Jerusalem, and Manasseh came to know the LORD is God.

key_moments.title: Clearing Out the Idols
key_moments.description: Back in Jerusalem, Manasseh removed the idol and the foreign gods from the LORD's house and threw out his altars. He repaired the LORD's altar and commanded Judah to worship the LORD, Israel's God.
